settings.description_override: A calmer beginning to a busy day. The Bag Organizer gives the small things a place of their own, from the keys you need first to the essentials you like close by. Its soft, structured felt brings order to a favorite tote without changing what you love about it.
settings.fact_detail: Thick matte felt, stitched edges and distinct pocket divisions create a tidy interior with a soft touch.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: An open-top felt insert with slip pockets and a central zipped divider. Choose Small, Medium or Large using the size selector, and compare those dimensions with your bag’s interior before ordering.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Empty the organizer, spot-clean with a damp cloth and let it air-dry completely. Reshape gently before returning it to your bag.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
